title: Every writer signs through the handle it writes with
note: Stage 2, S2-1. SS1 removes the seam itself. SS2 to SS4 remove each refusal a signing handle makes before a byte is written: an actor it holds no key for, an attestation file its reader does not read, a key the registry does not let sign. SS5 to SS8 remove each check on how a handle is built. tests/test_signing_seam.py holds each with a real GOVERNED history and the stores that govern it.

mutations.name: SS1_the_log_never_signs_with_its_handle
mutations.find:
if before_write is None and self.signing is not None:
            before_write = functools.partial(self.signing.prepare, self)
mutations.rationale: a store given a signing handle cannot write a governed history: every record it writes is refused unsigned

mutations.name: SS2_a_handle_signs_with_any_key_it_holds
mutations.rationale: a handle writes a record for an actor it holds no key for, signed (or refused only by the signer's own check) with another principal's key

mutations.name: SS3_the_attestation_file_is_not_checked
mutations.find:
if reads is not None and Path(reads.path).resolve() != \
                self.attestations.path.resolve():
mutations.rationale: a handle attests to a file its log's reader never reads, so the record it writes reads as unattested by every reader

mutations.name: SS4_the_registry_is_not_asked_whether_the_key_may_sign
mutations.rationale: a key the registry does not hold, or holds for another principal, signs a record and the record is written

mutations.name: SS5_two_keys_for_one_principal_are_held
mutations.rationale: a handle holds two keys for one principal and signs with whichever was given last

mutations.name: SS6_a_handle_with_no_key_is_built
mutations.find:
if not held:
            raise AuthenticationError("a signing handle holds no key")
mutations.replace:
if False:
            raise AuthenticationError("a signing handle holds no key")
mutations.rationale: a signing handle holding no key is built, and every write through it is refused only later

mutations.name: SS7_anything_is_taken_for_a_signer
mutations.find:
if not isinstance(s, Signer):
                raise AuthenticationError(f"{s!r} is not a signer")
mutations.replace:
if False:
                raise AuthenticationError(f"{s!r} is not a signer")
mutations.rationale: a name is taken for a signer, and the handle fails when it first signs instead of when it is built

mutations.name: SS8_anything_is_taken_for_an_attestation_file
mutations.rationale: a path string is taken for an attestation file, and the handle fails when it first signs
